Title: Update: SAP HANA on Azure Large Instances retirement extended to 31st Dec 2025 - transition to Virtual Machines

Body.Content:
In September 2022, we announced the upcoming retirement of SAP HANA Large Instance (Gen4 and Gen4.5) products on Azure, initially scheduled for 30 June 2025. Based on your valuable feedback and to provide additional time for your migration planning, we are extending the retirement date by six months to 31 December 2025.  

This extension gives you flexibility to assess and execute your migration to other SAP-certified Azure VMs. We recommend using the alternative VMs in the HANA Hardware Directory for enhanced capabilities and support.  

Required Action  

Evaluate and select your migration path to the recommended SAP certified Azure Virtual Machines in the HANA Hardware Directory and take into consideration the new retirement date to give you more time to plan for your migration 

Important Note on Pricing    

As part of the retirement extension, please be aware that continued use of SAP HANA Large Instance (Gen4 and Gen4.5) products on Azure beyond 31 December 2025 may be subject to a price increase. We encourage you to plan your migration accordingly to avoid any potential changes to pricing. 

Help and support  

If you have questions, get answers from community experts & Microsoft moderators about planned maintenance on Azure VM forums. If you have a support plan and you need technical help, create a support request.
